## Pagination.svelte

### `type PaginationVariant`

How the control is drawn.

### `interface Props`

- `page` :: The current page, 1-based. Two-way bindable.
- `onPageChange` :: Called whenever the current page changes.
- `count` :: The number of pages. Used when `total` is not provided.
- `total` :: The total number of items, divided by `pageSize` to get the page count.
- `pageSize` :: Items per page, used with `total`.
- `siblings` :: How many page numbers to show on each side of the current page.
- `boundaries` :: How many page numbers to keep at each end of the range.
- `gap` :: The space between the page controls.
- `form` :: `numbers` shows a range of pages; `simple` shows the position in words; `compact` shows only the current page.
- `size` :: The control height. Text follows this unless `textSize` is set.
- `textSize` :: The text scale, independent of the control height. Follows `size` when omitted.
- `textColor` :: The ink of the position line in the `simple` and `compact` forms.
- `childTextColor` :: The ink of the ellipsis and of the slash between the current page and the count.
- `href` :: Builds an `href` for a page, so the control renders links instead of buttons.
- `label` :: Accessible name of the navigation.
- `disabled` :: Dims the control and blocks every page button.

## pages.ts

### `type PageSlot`

A page number, or a gap in the range.

### `function pageSlots`

The visible page numbers around `page`, with `siblings` on each side and `boundaries` kept at each end, collapsing the rest into ellipses.
